messages.text: I closed the card I paid with yesterday. Could you send this refund to my new card instead?

I can’t redirect the refund to a different card. Refunds go only to the order’s original payment; closing the card doesn’t change that, and the card issuer handles any credit (refund-policy/v2/payment). Your BRL 77.90 refund is already recorded against that original payment, receipt R-00000001.
